voiceNote: Kokoro af_bella (Coach Bella), generated by the lead

chapters.label: Live: the problem
chapters.text: This is Ricardinho, Portugal’s futsal magician. The ball is on his wrong side, and a defender is rushing in.

chapters.label: Live: the rabona
chapters.text: No time to switch feet. So he wraps one leg behind the other. Goal!

chapters.label: Replay: behind the leg
chapters.text: Watch the replay. He plants his standing foot beside the ball, swings his kicking leg behind it, and strikes with the laces.

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: It curls past the defender! That’s a rabona. Practise it slowly: plant, swing behind, strike. Only use it when it’s the smart choice.
